answer: Make trust a signal grove no farm can plant overnight: a newcomer must first earn a relic, a signed record of useful work checked by unrelated veterans, before it may light its first signal fire. Fires are relayed from tree to tree by torch-bearers who rotate every epoch, so no clique can control the grove's light. Each fire burns only while fresh verified work feeds it, and a duplicate shows the same relic carried twice and is cut down. Sybil farms must earn a fresh relic, light a new fire, and survive rotating torch-bearers for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
